hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Harmonious pastel palette (coral/slate/teal) and clean card layout show genuine design intent, but the circle pack is clipped at the bottom edge — the main visualization is cut off and the viewer cannot see the full data structure.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct area encoding via scaleSqrt for force-layout circles, data-driven domain via d3.extent, proper key functions on node joins, and scaleSqrt on sunburst y-axis — no bar/area baseline violations apply to this topological chart type.
flags: Update Storm: easing-params sliders fire updateLayout() (full 1500ms re-transition) on every input event with no debounce or throttle
Update Storm: tension slider fires redrawLinks() updating 300+ link paths on every mousemove with no RAF coalescing
Mid-Flight Snap: no .interrupt() called on nodeSelection or linkSelection before new transitions begin — relies solely on D3 implicit scheduling
animationFrameId leak: regenerateAndRender() never cancels the previous FPS-counter requestAnimationFrame loop before re-initializing
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Two un-throttled input handlers trigger expensive full-scene re-transitions or 300+ DOM mutations per event, and missing .interrupt() calls leave mid-flight transitions vulnerable to snap artifacts on rapid layout switching.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Top-level color groups are clearly separated and readable, but 300 bundled edges converging at the circle pack center form a dark hairball that overwhelms the node structure beneath; animation quality across 7 layout transitions cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
